definitions.gloss: crest, coat of arms, emblem, heraldic symbol
definitions.explanation: A symbolic design used to identify a family, organization, or institution. In Japanese contexts, refers to family crests ({家紋|かもん}). In Western contexts, refers to coats of arms and heraldic symbols.

examples.japanese: ⟦{王家|おうけ}→王家：13548_ouke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紋章|もんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刻|きざ}まれている→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧。
examples.english: The royal coat of arms is engraved on it.
The knight's family crest is depicted on this shield.

examples.japanese: ⟦ヨーロッパ→ヨーロッパ：00427_yooroppa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{紋章|もんしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家柄|いえがら}→家柄：16695_iegara⟧や⟦{地位|ちい}→地位：03427_chii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦シンボル→シンボル：10948_shinboru⟧だった。
examples.english: In Europe, coats of arms were important symbols indicating family lineage and status.

notes:
USAGE:
{紋章|もんしょう} can refer to both Japanese ⟦{家紋|かもん}→家紋：15366_kamon⟧ (family crests) and Western heraldic designs. In practice, it is more commonly used for Western-style coats of arms and in fantasy/game contexts, while ⟦{家紋|かもん}→家紋：15366_kamon⟧ is preferred for traditional Japanese family crests.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紋章|もんしょう}{学|がく}: heraldry
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紋章|もんしょう}: family crest
- ⟦{王家|おうけ}→王家：13548_ouke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紋章|もんしょう}: royal coat of arms
- {紋章|もんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧: to display a coat of arms
